objectives.statement: Code, feedback, objectives, and controls have stable visual hierarchy
Players can select and enter levels and bosses from the campaign
Live fights and repairs keep resources and interpreter evidence visible
Compact, ASCII, no-color, and reduced-motion paths remain usable

evidence.method: python3.11 -m unittest discover -s tests outside restricted sandbox

evidence.claim: Real terminal interactions restore terminal settings
evidence.result: campaign to solved level and back; inspect and resume repair; live boss reference; all restore termios

evidence.method: capture showcase and levels --map via subprocess; assert no ESC bytes

evidence.result: 1420 tests OK in 62.732s, unpinned with host isolation backends

evidence.claim: The visual feel is better in sustained human play

misconceptions.believed: TerminalSession.resized was a method, following vision.play
misconceptions.revealed_by: real PTY campaign launch raised TypeError
misconceptions.corrected_to: It is a consuming boolean property; all affected call sites now read it
misconceptions.generalisable_lesson: Pure composition cannot verify terminal lifecycle contracts

decisions.decision: Reuse dependency-free cell grid and central style renderer
Wide inspectors plus scrollable full-width views
decisions.rationale: Preserve 48-column editing and access to long evidence
Failures and next actions take priority
Avoid stale caches and restoration errors

friction.description: System Python 3.14 and restricted sandbox prevented a usable initial baseline; Python 3.11 with host backend access passed

handoff.state: Visual overhaul implemented; not committed or pushed
